title: Brant/Voicelines
wikitext:
{{Resonator Tabs}} {{Language Tabs}} ==About Voicelines== {{VO |character = Brant |language = en |vo_01_01_title = Thoughts: I |vo_01_01_file = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg |vo_01_01_tx = I've got some time today. What would you say to a nice stroll on the beach? Maybe the sea breeze and ocean sunset will inspire you! |vo_01_02_title = Thoughts: II |vo_01_02_intimacy = 1 |vo_01_02_file = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg |vo_01_02_tx = When sailing the seas, always remember to set your course first, and then... adapt to whatever comes your way! |vo_01_03_title = Thoughts: III |vo_01_03_intimacy = 2 |vo_01_03_file = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg |vo_01_03_tx = Hey, here to see our performance? Take this ticket. No need to bring anything, just a smile and a heart full of excitement. But if you insist… Well, when I step on stage, be sure to give me all the applause and cheers you've got! |vo_01_04_title = Thoughts: IV |vo_01_04_intimacy = 3 |vo_01_04_file = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg |vo_01_04_tx = All I think about on stage is losing myself in the role—the stage becomes "my" entire world, with every light, note, and movement telling "my" story. Up there, the world is my oyster. But once I step off, I'm just a minor character in the tale of {{Rubi|Solaris|the world}}. |vo_01_05_title = Thoughts: V |vo_01_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_01_05_file = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg |vo_01_05_tx = See that? Over there, just around the corner—that's Trattoria Margherita. Nearly everyone in our troupe has walked this alley; it's where we grew up. Out at sea, I'd wonder how {{Extra Effect|Ragunna|Ragunna|One of the city-states in Rinascita, Ragunna is a thriving port city on the edge of the sea, its districts linked by winding waterways.
The Ragunnesi are devout followers of the Sentinel, who believe Common Echoes to be gifts from the Sentinel that carry Their divine will.}} could turn its back on us, or what I'd do when I finally returned. I pictured a hundred things… but now, standing here, all I want is a slice of pizza... The sights and sounds of this city have always been a part of me. |vo_02_01_title = Brant's Hobby |vo_02_01_file = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg |vo_02_01_tx = The boundless sea is the grandest stage, its towering waves our most thunderous applause! We sail with the currents and winds, hunting for cheers and laughter on every distant shore. Therefore, my friend, lift your voice and dance with abandon—for you, for me, and for every day we have lived in full! |vo_02_02_title = Brant's Trouble |vo_02_02_file = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg |vo_02_02_tx = *sigh* Ain't got no money... |vo_02_03_title = Favorite Food |vo_02_03_file = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg |vo_02_03_tx = Here, try this wine… A bit too sweet? Haha, that's just my "Strength!" Everyone's brew tastes different, you know. Battier's has a spicy edge, Tina's is rather refreshing. This is the Troupe's Strength… a blend of everyone's life. |vo_02_04_title = Disliked Food |vo_02_04_file = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg |vo_02_04_tx = For me, any food's fair game. C'mon, don't overthink it! When you're hungry enough, everything tastes amazing! |vo_02_05_title = Ideals |vo_02_05_file = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg |vo_02_05_tx = One day, our troupe will sail to every corner of the world, and every wave will echo a shared story—the tale of {{Rubi|the Fools|Freedom}}! |vo_03_01_title = Chat: I |vo_03_01_file = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg |vo_03_01_tx = Take this telescope and see for yourself… Even the highest clouds feel close enough to touch, don't they? With this gadget, you'll catch every thrill onstage and every "new world" waiting out at sea. |vo_03_02_title = Chat: II |vo_03_02_file = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg |vo_03_02_tx = Unforgettable adventures? Where to start? How about an ancient trial that spanned over a century? |vo_04_01_title = About [[Roccia]] |vo_04_01_intimacy = 1 |vo_04_01_file = {character}{language} About Roccia.ogg |vo_04_01_tx = Don't be fooled by our First Mate's age—if you ever need performance advice, she's your go-to. Plus, she's also an excellent stage designer! |vo_04_01_mention = Roccia |vo_04_02_title = About [[Carlotta]] |vo_04_02_intimacy = 2 |vo_04_02_file = {character}{language} About Carlotta.ogg |vo_04_02_tx = She's got her course set and sticks to it, no matter what. Living as a {{Extra Effect|Montelli|Montelli|One of the most powerful families in Ragunna, renowned for their pioneering spirit.
The Montelli family played an instrumental role in charting trade routes that not only connect Ragunna, but also greater Rinascita to the wider world. As the city opened its doors, the Montellis rose to prominence, amassing great wealth and unmatched influence.}} is no easy path, but she's determined to make her own way. And mark my words, when her performances draw to a close, she'll be known not just as a Montelli, but Carlotta. |vo_04_02_mention = Carlotta |vo_04_03_title = About [[Cartethyia]] |vo_04_03_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_03_file = {character}{language} About Cartethyia.ogg |vo_04_03_tx = Some call her a saint; others, a sinner. But who is she really? No one cares how she treats her friends or faces her foes. The Order's tales never speak of her dreams, and the legends conceal her heart's desire. Everyone has heard of Cartethyia—but does anyone know the person behind that name? |vo_04_03_mention = Cartethyia |vo_04_04_title = About [[Zani]] |vo_04_04_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_04_file = {character}{language} About Zani.ogg |vo_04_04_tx = Many wear masks to fit in, but not her. Whatever her past, whatever roles she's played, she's here now, true to herself. |vo_04_04_mention = Zani |vo_05_01_title = Birthday Wishes |vo_05_01_file = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg |vo_05_01_tx = Happy birthday, my dear friend! Got any plans today? How about slipping away with me for a little adventure? I'll even let you take the helm. Here, hold on tight—together, we'll sail into the far horizon! |vo_06_01_title = Idle: I |vo_06_01_file = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg |vo_06_01_tx = (Effort sound) |vo_06_02_title = Idle: II |vo_06_02_file = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg |vo_06_02_tx = Let me see... Aha! |vo_06_03_title = Idle: III |vo_06_03_file = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg |vo_06_03_tx = Hey, little one... There you go! |vo_07_01_title = Self-Introduction |vo_07_01_file = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg |vo_07_01_tx = Brant's the name, captain of the {{Extra Effect|Fool's Troupe|Troupe of Fools|A troupe formed by exiles drifted to the Penitent's End on the Pilgrim's Sails for their supposed "transgressions."
To reveal the truth hidden by the Order, they wrote numerous plays and "danced in chains," performing tirelessly across the archipelago.}}! A pleasure to meet you, and please, call me whatever you'd like, for I'm but a humble Fool in pursuit of freedom. Enough with introductions now. Let's hand the stage over to everlasting joy and boundless liberty! |vo_07_02_title = Greeting |vo_07_02_file = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg |vo_07_02_tx = The curtains pull back and I'm here to hunt for every laugh! Brant, at your service. A pleasure to make your acquaintance. |vo_08_01_title = Join Team: I |vo_08_01_file = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg |vo_08_01_tx = The course is determined. Time to set sail! |vo_08_02_title = Join Team: II |vo_08_02_file = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg |vo_08_02_tx = Rage on, approaching storm! |vo_08_03_title = Join Team: III |vo_08_03_file = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg |vo_08_03_tx = Applaud for me, dear friend! |vo_09_01_title = Ascension: I |vo_09_01_ascension = 1 |vo_09_01_file = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg |vo_09_01_tx = With this, the stage is set for a grand opening. Come on, trim the sails! |vo_09_02_title = Ascension: II |vo_09_02_ascension = 2 |vo_09_02_file = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg |vo_09_02_tx = More power... Now we're storm-proof and unstoppable! Let's go, full speed ahead! |vo_09_03_title = Ascension: III |vo_09_03_ascension = 3 |vo_09_03_file = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg |vo_09_03_tx = We're smooth sailing now. Onto the next stop... Hard to portside! |vo_09_04_title = Ascension: IV |vo_09_04_ascension = 4 |vo_09_04_file = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg |vo_09_04_tx = With your strength, this massive wave is just a splash in our show! Bring it on! |vo_09_05_title = Ascension: V |vo_09_05_ascension = 5 |vo_09_05_file = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg |vo_09_05_tx = Haha! Now this is the strength worthy of a true swordsman of the seas! Join me on this voyage to the world's end, my friend! Together, we'll face that fleeting moment when the world turns upside down! }} ==Combat== {{Combat VO |character = Brant |language = en |aerial_1_tx = More passion! |aerial_2_tx = Listen carefully! |aerial_3_tx = Victory's mine! |aerial_4_tx = Perfect finale! |aerial_5_tx = Keep the cheers coming! |aerial_6_tx = Here's to me! |heavy_1_tx = Right behind you! |heavy_2_tx = Focus, will you? |resskill_1_tx = Don't blink. |resliberation_1_tx = In the limelight! |resliberation_2_tx = Climax of the show! |resliberation_3_tx = Let the flames rise! |introoutro_1_tx = Epic shot. |introoutro_2_tx = At the helm. |hit_1_tx = Careful! |hit_2_tx = No worries. |hit_3_tx = A little mishap. |injured_1_tx = 'Tis but a splash. |injured_2_tx = Let the tempest strike harder! |injured_3_tx = Haha, this is getting fun! |fallen_1_tx = The curtain falls... |fallen_2_tx = This is... not the end... |fallen_3_tx = The Fool's... final act… |esummon_1_tx = Your moment on stage! |etransform_1_tx = Same actor, different role! |enemynear_1_tx = Brant salutes you. |glider_1_tx = Beyond my beloved horizon! |sensor_1_tx = The compass points... this way! |dash_1_tx = First to the treasure! |chest_1_tx = Any wine inside? |chest_2_tx = The scent of history. |chest_3_tx = You earned it, you keep it. }} ==Change History== {{Change History|2.1}} ==Navigation== {{Resonator Navbox|type=voicelines}}
